items.headline: Stocks Fall Amid Geopolitical Tensions, Rising Oil Prices, and Soaring Bond Yields
items.summary: U.S. equity markets experienced a broad decline on Tuesday as renewed U.S.-Iran hostilities in the Strait of Hormuz drove oil prices higher and escalated geopolitical uncertainty. Investors also contended with rising global bond yields and concerns over stubbornly high inflation and government debt. All major indices finished lower for the day.

items.headline: Moderna Rises on Positive Melanoma Vaccine Trial Results
items.summary: Moderna shares gained 3.8% following positive late-stage Phase 3 trial results for its personalized mRNA melanoma vaccine developed in partnership with Merck.

items.headline: Apple Climbs on Analyst Updates and iPhone Anticipation
items.summary: Apple rose 2.6% today, driven by positive analyst price-target updates and investor anticipation ahead of its upcoming iPhone launch event.

items.headline: Workday Up After Earnings and Buyback Program
items.summary: Workday gained 2.5% following its fiscal second-quarter earnings report and the authorization of a $4 billion stock buyback program.

items.headline: Duolingo Posts Gains Following Analyst Upgrades
items.summary: Duolingo's shares gained 5.44% today, reaching $156.51, following favorable analyst upgrades.

items.headline: Lumentum Holdings Declines Amid Industry Selling
items.summary: Photonic products maker Lumentum Holdings lost 6.4%, attributed to industry-wide 'sympathy selling' and profit-taking.

items.headline: Microsoft Among Tech Stocks Weighing on Market
items.summary: Microsoft shares fell 1.3% as technology stocks were among the heaviest weights on the market, impacted by rising borrowing costs.

items.headline: Advanced Micro Devices Falls as Tech Sector Pressured
items.summary: Advanced Micro Devices saw its shares decline by 3%, reflecting the broader pressure on technology stocks from rising interest rates.

items.headline: SpaceX Down in Premarket After Foundry Plans Revealed
items.summary: SpaceX shares were down 1.31% to $141.81 in premarket trading after CEO Elon Musk confirmed plans for the company to build a specialized in-house foundry.

items.headline: Manufacturing PMI Shows Expansion, Job Openings Little Changed
items.summary: Economic activity in the manufacturing sector expanded for the eighth consecutive month in August, with the ISM Manufacturing PMI registering 54.6%, slightly down from July's 55.6%. Meanwhile, the number of job openings remained largely unchanged at 7.3 million in July, according to the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics.

items.headline: U.S.-Iran Hostilities Drive Oil Prices and Inflation Concerns
items.summary: Renewed hostilities between the U.S. and Iran in the Strait of Hormuz led to a significant jump in oil prices, with Brent crude rising 3.9% to $94 a barrel. This geopolitical tension is contributing to inflation concerns and uncertainty in the markets.

items.headline: Treasury Yields Climb, Pressuring Equities
items.summary: U.S. Treasury yields continued their ascent, with the 10-year yield hovering around 4.78% and the 30-year yield just under 5.3%. These elevated yields are increasing borrowing costs and reducing the attractiveness of equities, particularly higher-valued technology stocks.

items.headline: Technology and Consumer Discretionary Lag, Consumer Staples and Energy Lead
items.summary: Today's intraday sector performance saw Information Technology (-1.75%) and Consumer Discretionary (-1.36%) as the leading lagging sectors. Conversely, Consumer Staples (+0.94%) and Energy (+0.81%) showed strength. (Intraday performance as of 10:00 AM ET)

items.headline: NIO Reports Strong Q2 2026 Revenue Growth
items.summary: NIO Inc. ($NIO) announced Q2 2026 total revenues of RMB32,136.9 million (US$4,736.4 million), marking a 69.1% increase year-over-year. Vehicle sales surged by 80.1%, contributing to a gross margin of 18.4% for the quarter.
